name: Telegram Bulk Activity Check
description: Registration status plus username, user ID, last-seen time, active days and the member flag across a whole list.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether the number is registered on Telegram.

result_fields.name: username
result_fields.description: Username, empty when the account has none.

result_fields.name: lastseen
result_fields.description: The most recent online time observed.

result_fields.name: activedays
result_fields.description: Days since that activity — smaller is more recent.

result_fields.name: member
result_fields.description: Whether the account has Telegram Premium.
